Exact marginal log-likelihood of a crossed/nested Gaussian MET model (Stage-3)

Source: R/re_marginal.R
dot-re_marginal_gaussian_met.Rd

Computes log N(y | eta_fixed, V) with the structured dense marginal covariance V = sigma^2 I + sum_r tau_r^2 Z_r Z_r', via a Cholesky of V. This is the exact marginal of a Gaussian linear mixed model with one or more crossed (or nested) random intercepts — the random effects integrated out, not sampled.

Usage

.re_marginal_gaussian_met(y, eta_fixed, factors, taus, sigma)

Arguments

y

Response vector (length N).

eta_fixed

Fixed-part linear predictor (length N).

factors

The per-grouping list from .build_re_design() (each carries the integer group index and the group count).

taus

Vector of random-intercept SDs, one per grouping (>= 0).

sigma

Residual SD (> 0).

Value

A scalar log marginal likelihood (-Inf if V is not positive-definite under the proposed variance components).
